title: Implement a Trie in Go
description: Implement a Trie with Insert(word string), Search(word string) bool, and StartsWith(prefix string) bool.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Trie in trie.go:
- Node struct with `children map[rune]*Node` and `isEnd bool`
- `New()`: return &Trie{root: &Node{children: make(map[rune]*Node)}}
- `Insert`: walk runes, create nodes as needed, mark last node isEnd=true
- `Search`: walk runes; return false if any node missing; return node.isEnd
- `StartsWith`: walk runes; return false if any node missing; return true
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
